title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our 2026 guide, covering prices and options by suburb
intro: Aucklanders have a wide range of gym options to choose from, with prices starting from $15 per week. With so many options, it can be overwhelming to decide which gym is best for you. This guide will help you navigate the best gyms in Auckland, including options in the CBD and surrounding suburbs.

sections.heading: CBD Gym Options
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with options such as Les Mills, Snap Fitness, and Anytime Fitness. These gyms offer a range of services, including group fitness classes and personal training.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: For those who work in the city but live in the surrounding suburbs, there are several gym options that are convenient for commuters. These include the Les Mills gym on Victoria St and the Snap Fitness gym on Queen St.

sections.heading: Auckland Suburbs
list: North Shore: Les Mills, Snap Fitness, Anytime Fitness
West Auckland: Jetts Fitness, City Fitness
South Auckland: Anytime Fitness, Les Mills
East Auckland: Snap Fitness, Jetts Fitness

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: Parking can be a challenge in the Auckland CBD, but many gyms offer on-site parking or are located near public transport hubs. It's worth considering the location and accessibility of a gym when choosing which one to join.

sections.heading: Join Les Mills Auckland
sections.body: Les Mills is one of the most popular gyms in Auckland, with several locations throughout the city. You can join Les Mills from $24.95 per week, with a 12-month contract.
